policy: Short authored observations only; no upstream source code stored. Pixel representations are separate from these notes.

patterns.label: disclosure
patterns.text: disclose details progressively expandable sections hierarchy compact settings reduce density
patterns.note: Keep a labelled trigger separate from its panel. Expansion should preserve keyboard focus.

patterns.label: alternatives
patterns.text: compare alternatives switch views tabs selection preserve local state preview
patterns.note: Use a shared tab list when panels describe alternatives in the same context.

patterns.label: context
patterns.text: inspect preview contextual details floating panel anchor dismiss escape reversible
patterns.note: Keep a contextual panel tied to its trigger, with predictable dismissal and focus return.

patterns.label: search
patterns.text: search filter choices autocomplete pick options keyboard list input
patterns.note: Text entry and option selection need coordinated labels, active state and keyboard behaviour.

patterns.label: collection
patterns.text: organize collection reorder cards select items list drag keyboard actions
patterns.note: Treat collection selection and item actions as distinct interactions; provide a keyboard route.

patterns.label: rehearsal
patterns.text: rehearse preview adjust compare amount range control continuous change value
patterns.note: A continuous adjustment needs a readable value and keyboard increments, not only a draggable thumb.

patterns.label: command
patterns.text: command palette search action menu navigate commands filter history shortcut
patterns.note: A command surface groups searchable actions and keeps keyboard selection visible.
